description: Squared-error IRMv1: each environment contributes mean squared error plus penalty_weight times the squared derivative of that mean risk with respect to a shared scalar output scale at 1.0. The scalar-classifier objective appears in §3.1.4, Eq. (6), the gradient penalty in §3.1.5, and the MSE specialization in Appendix D of the IRM paper. This computes the exact empirical mean-risk gradient square; structured-objective bindings are implemented at src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:40-50.

examples.title: Train a regression model with IRMv1

name: Invariant Risk Minimization loss (IRMv1)

parameters.additional parameters: Unsupported parameter names passed through **params raise ValueError
parameters.environment_ids: Required numeric tensor with shape [N], one finite integer-valued ID per sample; integral-valued floats are accepted and at least two distinct environments are required
parameters.ignore_index: Must be None because squared-error regression has no ignored class index
parameters.logits_or_prediction: Floating-point prediction tensor shaped [N, ...] with N > 0; all trailing output dimensions share one scalar scale
parameters.penalty_weight: Finite nonnegative real number lambda multiplying the squared risk derivative (API default 1.0; the paper leaves lambda tunable)
parameters.reduction: none returns one environment term per distinct ID; mean averages terms (default); sum matches the paper's environment sum
parameters.targets: Floating-point tensor matching the prediction shape and device
